title: An Investigation Into The Impact Of Enteric Coated Of Aspirin In Patients With Newly Diagnosed Ischemic Stroke.

sections.abstract: Uncertainty remains regarding the impact of enteric-coated (EC) aspirin as it relates to the reduction of CV risk. We hypothesize that EC formulation based on the previous report may blunt aspirin response as evidenced by reduced Thromboxane A2 (TXA 2) levels in diabetic patients.
